label: MX204 universal routing platform
description: 1 RU 400 Gbps fixed-configuration edge router: eight 10GE SFP+ ports on PIC 1 plus four rate-selectable QSFP28 ports (PIC 0) that run as 100GE, 40GE, or four 10GE breakouts each, and a single 1G RJ-45 management port. No copper data ports and no line-card slots - the MX204 is fully fixed, with one built-in Routing Engine and 1+1 power supplies.
notes: MX204 chassis documentation: "four rate-selectable ports that can be configured as 100-Gigabit Ethernet ports or 40-Gigabit Ethernet ports, or each port can be configured as four 10-Gigabit Ethernet ports (by using a breakout cable). The MX204 also has eight 10-Gigabit Ethernet ports. The four rate-selectable ports support QSFP28 and QSFP+ transceivers, whereas the eight 10-Gigabit Ethernet ports support SFP+ transceivers." Juniper's port-speed guide splits the router into fixed-port PIC 0 (ports 0-3, 100/40/10G) and MIC PIC 1 (ports 0-7, 10G), which is why the interfaces are et-0/0/0-3 and xe-0/1/0-7. Breakout is one physical cage, so each QSFP28 is a single interface with 40G/100G speed caps.
